description: This PHP source file defines a class `View` within the namespace `SuiteCRM\modules\Administration\Search`. It is responsible for rendering the search settings page of the SuiteCRM administration module, including handling the display logic and assigning variables to the Smarty templating engine. It includes methods for pre-display processing and the main display action, interacting with search engines and modules.

classes.name: View
classes.description: A class extending `AbstractView` that renders the search settings page within the SuiteCRM admin module.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the view with the template located at `/view.tpl`.

methods.name: preDisplay
methods.description: Prepares data for display, including assigning the current search controller, engine, and available engines to Smarty variables.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Main display method that assigns app and module strings, retrieves enabled and disabled search modules, and renders the Smarty template.
